text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clearer paragraphing with first \"First\" and \"Another reason\"","quality":"organization","description":"The essay is more logically organized into recognizable parts that help guide the reader through its ideas."},{"evidence":"uses a quoted saying and then explains it","quality":"development","description":"The essay develops its main point with a relevant quotation and follow-up explanation rather than only listing claims."},{"evidence":"\"we feel better knowing that we did our best\"","quality":"idea elaboration","description":"The essay gives more extended elaboration of its reasons and includes concrete explanation of why challenging goals matter."},{"evidence":"\"when I was 11 years old...play soccer\"","quality":"relevant example","description":"The essay supports its argument with a more coherent personal example that is connected to the point being made."},{"evidence":"\"feel proud and confident of ourselves\"","quality":"sentence control","description":"The essay shows somewhat more control over complete sentence structures and communicates its ideas more clearly despite errors."}]}
